records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $187.6 million for the three months ended June 30, 2022 compared to $157.5 million in the three months ended June 30, 2021, an increase of $30.1, or 19.1%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $290.2 million for the six months ended June 30, 2022 compared to $260.9 million in the six months ended June 30, 2021, an increase of $29.3 million, or 11.2%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales at our Work Truck Attachments segment were $130.4 million for the three months ended June 30, 2022 compared to $104.6 million in the three months ended June 30, 2021, an increase of $25.8 million.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales for the three and six months ended June 30, 2022 compared to the same periods in 2021 is a result of pricing actions in both segments, as well as strong preseason order demand in our Work Truck Attachments segment leading to increased volumes.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities decreased $71.3 million from the six months ended June 30, 2021 to the six months ended June 30, 2022.
